race.comment: KHAN CAPITAL (4) settled well back and never threatened when eighth over 1860m at Avoca last time out. The previous run is probably a better guide to his chances though. He started $7.50 in a much, much tougher race than this, when fourth, and is better suited at this trip. RUTHLESS SOUL (8) only beat one home on debut, but it was in a race of much more depth than what she strikes here and she'll be aided by the raise in trip. Barrier one is just the icing on the cake. PATH TO VICTORY (5) returned from a spell three weeks ago when he was beaten 6 lengths into eighth over 1400m at Hamilton. Finds a more suitable contest and can get the job done. EMINENT ELLA (6) is a nine-start maiden who could only manage to finish sixth at her latest appearance over 2100m at Horsham after she got a long way back in the run. Draws better here and will appreciate the trip. AN POITIN STILL (1) is already for this distance and should be nearing peak fitness.
